answer.text: The spread is mainly reaction-time variation, greater than the stopwatch display resolution. Mean time = 2.39 s, reasonably quoted as (2.4 ± 0.1) s. With g = 2s/t², g ≈ 2.6 m s⁻². Adding fractional uncertainties gives Δg/g ≈ 0.01/7.64 + 2(0.1/2.4), so g ≈ (2.6 ± 0.2) m s⁻².
